profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Microsoft
profile.summary: I’m a software engineer with 5 years of professional experience building and shipping production systems across the full stack. I enjoy working on complex problems where product, platform, and user experience intersect, turning ambiguous requirements into scalable, reliable solutions. My experience includes delivering customer facing features, contributing to platform launches, and collaborating closely with product managers, designers, and partner teams to drive outcomes.

positions.title: Software Engineer II - PowerBI
positions.description:
- Contributed to the successful general availability launch of Power BI Web Modeling
- Developing agentic systems to help customers build Microsoft Fabric solutions using natural language

positions.title: Software Engineer - PowerBI
positions.description: - Delivered full-stack contributions across multiple key features of Power BI Web Modeling

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
•	Taught a class of 20 students the fundamentals of computer science and how to program in Java. 
•	Maintained weekly office hours and problem-solving session. 
•	Graded weekly assignments and exams.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
•	Developed a REST API using Golang to automate onboarding new applications and services onto Kubernetes clusters
•	Built a UI using React and a CLI for users to consume the API
•	Wrote unit tests for Golang API functions and React components

positions.title: Technology Associate
positions.description:
•	Decreased the load time of The Crimson by adopting Google’s AMP project into the existing framework
•	Standardized coding practices in order to have a more maintainable code base
•	Improved overall user interface and design of the site

positions.title: Summer School Proctor
positions.description:
-Responsible for ensuring the safety and well-being of high school students as well as giving information and guidance.
-First point of contact between students and the administration.

honors.title: Northrop Grumman Engineering Scholar
honors.description: Northrop Grumman Engineering Scholars program provides scholarships to promising Maryland high school seniors who intend to pursue a career in engineering, computer science, mathematics, or physics. The award is based on both academic achievement and community service.

honors.title: Eagle Scout
honors.description:
-Highest Honor in Boy Scouts of America.
-Scouts are required to do a service project that benefits his surrounding community.
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America · Feb 2016
